about: Riddles for LittleBot (littlebot/games/voice/riddles.py): q (the riddle), say (the answer as spoken), accept (answers that count, matched forgivingly), hint.

riddles.q: What has to be broken before you can use it?
riddles.hint: You might find a dozen of them in the fridge.

riddles.q: I'm tall when I'm young and short when I'm old. What am I?
What month of the year has 28 days?
What is full of holes but still holds water?
riddles.hint: You'll find me by the kitchen sink.

riddles.q: What question can you never answer yes to?
riddles.hint: You'd have to be snoozing to answer it.

riddles.q: What is always in front of you but can't be seen?
A one-storey house is all yellow: yellow walls, yellow doors, yellow furniture. What colour are its stairs?
riddles.say: There are no stairs: it's a one-storey house
riddles.hint: How many floors does the house have?

riddles.q: What can you break without ever touching it?
riddles.hint: You can make one with your pinky.

riddles.q: What goes up but never comes down?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
riddles.hint: You use me after a bath.

riddles.q: I have keys but no locks, space but no room, and you can enter but not go outside. What am I?
What has a head and a tail but no body?
What has hands but can't clap?
What has legs but doesn't walk?
What has one eye but can't see?
What can travel all around the world while staying in a corner?
riddles.hint: Look at the corner of an envelope.

riddles.q: What has lots of teeth but can't bite?
What runs but never walks, and has a mouth but never talks?
The more of this there is, the less you see. What is it?
What has a neck but no head?
What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?
I'm as light as a feather, but even the strongest person can't hold me for long. What am I?
What has words but never speaks?
riddles.hint: You'll find me on a shelf.

riddles.q: What can fill a room but takes up no space?
If you drop me I'll crack, but smile at me and I'll smile back. What am I?
What kind of band never plays any music?
What has a thumb and four fingers but isn't alive?
What goes up and down but doesn't move?
What do you call a bear with no teeth?
What starts with T, ends with T, and has T in it?
What has four wheels and flies?
riddles.hint: Think about the bugs, not the wings.

riddles.q: Where does today come before yesterday?
What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
riddles.hint: Look at how the words are spelled.

riddles.q: I have branches, but no fruit, trunk or leaves. What am I?
What can you catch but not throw?
What has one head, one foot and four legs?
Which is heavier: a kilogram of feathers or a kilogram of bricks?
riddles.say: Neither: they both weigh a kilogram

riddles.q: What can you hold in your right hand, but never in your left hand?
What is so fragile that saying its name breaks it?
What has ears but can't hear?
Which building has the most stories?
What gets bigger the more you take away from it?
What invention lets you look right through a wall?
What has many keys but can't open a single door?
What goes through cities and fields but never moves?
What has a face and two hands but no arms or legs?
